QuestInfo.name: [Fox Valley] Master Crafter Maru
QuestInfo.0: All #b#p3002020##k wants to do is prank villagers with sneezing powder! How is that supposed to help protect the village? You should talk to him in #b#m410000110##k to see what he's planning next.
QuestInfo.1: The self-proclaimed Master Crafter but not Gatherer, #b#p3002020##k, claims he can make a pair of ears so convincing that you'll look just like a fox. But naturally, he needs you to gather #b#i4036316# #t4036316##k x50 from #r#o2400252##k monsters in #b#m410000113##k for him.
QuestInfo.2: Since you've collected enough materials, Master Crafter #b#p3002020##k said he's ready to make a fine and furry set of ears for you.

default.0: You can get #b#i4036316# #t4036316##k by defeating #r#o2400252##k monsters in #b#m410000113##k. I think #b50#k should be enough.
